en: The postcard features two black-and-white images framed by decorative floral motifs. The left image shows a large crowd gathered along a riverbank, likely observing high water or flooding; boats or barges are visible on the river. The right image depicts significant flooding in an urban area with water inundating the street and buildings, including a prominent multi-story structure. The text at the bottom in Romanian reads: 'Salutare din Braila, Inondatiune Portului 1896.' There is also cursive handwriting at the bottom and postal marks.
